articles.title: Trump Says Credit Card Firms Violate Law If Rates Not Capped
articles.mainIdea: Trump Says Credit Card Firms Violate Law If Rates Not Capped
articles.summary: Bloomberg: Trump Says Credit Card Firms Violate Law If Rates Not Capped. Trump, speaking Sunday to reporters on Air Force One as he returned to Washington from Florida, doubled down on his demand that card issuers lower interest rates to 10% and keep them there for one year. “They really abused the credit cards,” he said of major lenders.
